flags.why: “Lifelong” incorrectly limits the meaning to one lifetime, whereas truyền kiếp describes something persisting across generations or lifetimes ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/truyen-kiep-eRKEfoBBlSVzt.html)).
flags.fix: age-old; persisting across generations (of enmity or other adverse conditions)

flags.why: The example defines the body part instead of showing the word in use.

flags.why: Xung does not mean physiological throbbing here; its pulse-related meaning concerns a brief signal or impulse ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xung)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.
